points.K5: 检漏：带压检漏，严禁明火
points.K6: 检漏液逐个涂接头，冒泡就是漏

points.K8: 用毕先关瓶阀，瓶内留余压
points.K9: 泄漏的危害：扩散加气体本身危害

points.K12: 可燃气体泄漏：关阀通风，杜绝火源

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一只固定好的气瓶旁，手拿检漏液洗瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a chained gas cylinder holding a squeeze bottle of leak test solution, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：调压、检漏与泄漏处置。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰正对着瓶阀，一下把瓶阀拧开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands right in front of a cylinder valve and twists it open in one quick turn.
shots.narration: 阿杰正对瓶阀，一下拧到底。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 接头嘶嘶作响，他拿打火机凑过去
shots.prompt_en: A fitting hisses and the young male student holds up a lighter towards it, a warning triangle flashing.
shots.narration: 接头嘶嘶响，他想拿火试试。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研一把拦住，递上检漏液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops his hand and hands him a squeeze bottle of leak test solution.
shots.narration: 小研：快停！检漏只能用检漏液！

shots.section_title: 开阀前：看环境，阀前不堆物
shots.scene: 可燃气瓶周围没有明火和热源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flammable gas cylinder in a clear area, a flame and a hot plate nearby crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃气体，周围不能有明火热源。
overlay: 开阀前：看环境，阀前不堆物

shots.section_title: 开阀前：看环境，阀前不堆物
shots.scene: 有毒气体在气瓶柜里使用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a toxic gas cylinder inside a ventilated gas cabinet with an exhaust arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 有毒气体，在气瓶柜或通风处用。

shots.section_title: 开阀前：看环境，阀前不堆物
shots.scene: 瓶阀前空出通道，伸手可关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clear path to a cylinder valve, boxes stacked in front of another cylinder crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 阀前不堆东西，随时伸手能关。

shots.section_title: 开阀前：看环境，阀前不堆物
shots.scene: 下游管路和仪器先接好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas line connected from the regulator to an instrument, each joint ticked before the valve opens. No text.
shots.narration: 下游管路和仪器，要先接好。

shots.section_title: 开瓶阀：站侧面，用手慢慢开
shots.scene: 确认调压手轮已松到底
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator adjusting knob turned fully counterclockwise with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 开瓶阀前，调压手轮先松到底。
overlay: 开瓶阀：站侧面，用手慢慢开

shots.section_title: 开瓶阀：站侧面，用手慢慢开
shots.scene: 人站侧面，出口不对人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing beside a cylinder with the valve outlet and regulator facing away, a person in front crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 人站侧面，出口和表都别对着人。

shots.section_title: 开瓶阀：站侧面，用手慢慢开
shots.scene: 手不放在阀门正上方
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand holding the side of a valve handwheel, a hand over the top of the valve crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手也别放在阀门正上方。

shots.section_title: 开瓶阀：站侧面，用手慢慢开
shots.scene: 【实拍】侧身站立，用手慢慢逆时针打开瓶阀（惰性气体，系统正常）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand slowly turning a cylinder valve handwheel counterclockwise, the person standing to the side.
shots.narration: 用手慢慢开，让减压阀慢慢升压。

shots.section_title: 开瓶阀：站侧面，用手慢慢开
shots.scene: 加力杆和锤子开阀打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cheater bar and a hammer on a cylinder valve, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只用手开，不加力不敲，专用扳手除外。

shots.section_title: 看进口压力表，偏低要报告
shots.scene: 进口压力表指针高亮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator inlet gauge highlighted, the needle within a green band, no numbers. No text.
shots.narration: 开阀后看进口表，读数应在预期内。
overlay: 看进口压力表，偏低要报告

shots.section_title: 看进口压力表，偏低要报告
shots.scene: 读数偏低：快用空或瓶阀漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gauge needle reading low, two icons, an almost empty cylinder and a leaking valve. No text.
shots.narration: 偏低？可能快空了，也可能在漏。

shots.section_title: 看进口压力表，偏低要报告
shots.scene: 小研打电话报告负责人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a low gauge and phones the lab supervisor.
shots.narration: 先别急着用，告诉实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 调压：慢转手轮，出口阀只管流量
shots.scene: 【实拍】一边慢慢顺时针转调压手轮，一边看出口压力表（惰性气体）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand slowly turning a regulator adjusting knob clockwise while the outlet gauge needle rises gently.
shots.narration: 慢转调压手轮，看表调到规定压力。
overlay: 调压：慢转手轮，出口阀只管流量

shots.section_title: 调压：慢转手轮，出口阀只管流量
shots.scene: 表的满刻度不等于安全压力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gauge with the needle at full scale crossed out, a lower working mark with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 表的满刻度，不是安全工作压力。

shots.section_title: 调压：慢转手轮，出口阀只管流量
shots.scene: 再慢慢打开出口阀供气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand slowly opening the small outlet valve, gas flowing gently to the instrument. No text.
shots.narration: 再慢慢打开出口阀，向系统供气。

shots.section_title: 调压：慢转手轮，出口阀只管流量
shots.scene: 出口阀管流量，调压手轮管压力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, the outlet valve with a flow arrow and the adjusting knob with a gauge. No text.
shots.narration: 出口阀只管流量，压力靠手轮调。

shots.section_title: 调压：慢转手轮，出口阀只管流量
shots.scene: 通气后压力略降，复核微调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the outlet gauge needle dropping slightly when gas flows, then a hand making a small adjustment. No text.
shots.narration: 通气后压力略降，复核再微调。

shots.section_title: 检漏：带压检漏，严禁明火
shots.scene: 系统带压，准备检漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressurised gas system with joints highlighted and a magnifier, before the instrument is used. No text.
shots.narration: 用气之前，先在带压状态下检漏。
overlay: 检漏：带压检漏，严禁明火

shots.section_title: 检漏：带压检漏，严禁明火
shots.scene: 气泡法和电子检漏仪
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a squeeze bottle making bubbles and a handheld electronic leak detector. No text.
shots.narration: 可用检漏液，也可用电子检漏仪。

shots.section_title: 检漏：带压检漏，严禁明火
shots.scene: 用明火检漏打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lighter flame held near a gas joint, crossed out in red. No text.
shots.narration: 无论什么情况，严禁明火检漏！

shots.section_title: 检漏：带压检漏，严禁明火
shots.scene: 氧气系统用无油检漏液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen regulator with a bottle of oil free leak test solution and a tick, an oily soap crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 方法要和气体相容，氧气用无油的。

shots.section_title: 检漏：带压检漏，严禁明火
shots.scene: 关断气源后看压力表是否下降
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed system with a gauge watched over a clock, the needle holding steady. No text.
shots.narration: 也可按规程做保压检查，看表降不降。

shots.section_title: 检漏液逐个涂接头，冒泡就是漏
shots.scene: 【实拍】把检漏液从洗瓶挤到瓶阀与减压阀的连接处（惰性气体，系统正常）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a squeeze bottle applying leak test solution onto the joint between a cylinder valve and a regulator.
shots.narration: 检漏液装洗瓶，挤在每个接头上。
overlay: 检漏液逐个涂接头，冒泡就是漏

shots.section_title: 检漏液逐个涂接头，冒泡就是漏
shots.scene: 出口阀和管路接头也涂到
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator outlet valve and tubing joints each marked with a drop icon, one after another. No text.
shots.narration: 出口阀、管路接头，一个不漏。

shots.section_title: 检漏液逐个涂接头，冒泡就是漏
shots.scene: 【实拍】接头处检漏液不冒泡（系统正常）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a fitting covered with leak test solution and no bubbles forming.
shots.narration: 不冒泡才合格，确认无漏再用气。

shots.section_title: 检漏液逐个涂接头，冒泡就是漏
shots.scene: 持续冒泡的接头打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fitting with a growing cluster of bubbles, marked with a red warning. No text.
shots.narration: 气泡不断冒出来，就是漏气。

shots.section_title: 检漏液逐个涂接头，冒泡就是漏
shots.scene: 【实拍】检漏后用纸巾擦干接头
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand wiping a fitting dry with a paper towel after the leak test.
shots.narration: 检漏后擦干，免得腐蚀接头。

shots.section_title: 检漏液逐个涂接头，冒泡就是漏
shots.scene: 检漏记录表定期登记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank checklist with ticks, a calendar and a cylinder icon. No text.
shots.narration: 定期检漏，每次登记留存。

shots.section_title: 漏了：先泄压再紧固，还漏就报告
shots.scene: 带压拧接头打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrench on a bubbling fitting while the gauge shows pressure, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 发现漏气，不要带压去拧。
overlay: 漏了：先泄压再紧固，还漏就报告

shots.section_title: 漏了：先泄压再紧固，还漏就报告
shots.scene: 关瓶阀，泄压，紧固，再加压复查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four step icons, a closed cylinder valve, a gauge at zero, a wrench tightening, a bubble check. No text.
shots.narration: 关瓶阀、泄压、紧固，再检一遍。

shots.section_title: 漏了：先泄压再紧固，还漏就报告
shots.scene: 还漏：挂牌停用，报告负责人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator with an out of service tag, a person phoning the supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 还漏就挂牌停用，报告更换。

shots.section_title: 用毕先关瓶阀，瓶内留余压
shots.scene: 用完先关瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: step one icon, a hand closing the cylinder valve clockwise. No text.
shots.narration: 用完，先关气瓶上的瓶阀。
overlay: 用毕先关瓶阀，瓶内留余压

shots.section_title: 用毕先关瓶阀，瓶内留余压
shots.scene: 【实拍】关瓶阀后放掉余气，两表回零（惰性气体）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: both regulator gauge needles falling back to zero after the cylinder valve is closed.
shots.narration: 再放掉余气，表针回零。

shots.section_title: 用毕先关瓶阀，瓶内留余压
shots.scene: 松开调压手轮，关出口阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand loosening the adjusting knob, then closing the outlet valve. No text.
shots.narration: 松开手轮，关好出口阀。

shots.section_title: 用毕先关瓶阀，瓶内留余压
shots.scene: 只关出口阀打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: only the regulator outlet valve closed while the cylinder valve stays open, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只关减压阀，不算关好。

shots.section_title: 用毕先关瓶阀，瓶内留余压
shots.scene: 瓶内留有余压，防止倒灌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder with a small remaining pressure band, air and moisture blocked from flowing back in. No text.
shots.narration: 气不用尽，留余压，防止倒灌。

shots.section_title: 泄漏的危害：扩散加气体本身危害
shots.scene: 氢气从阀门喷出，扩散很远
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gas jetting from a cylinder valve and spreading far across a room as a faint cloud. No text.
shots.narration: 高压推着气体，跑得又快又远。
overlay: 泄漏的危害：扩散加气体本身危害

shots.section_title: 泄漏的危害：扩散加气体本身危害
shots.scene: 可燃、有毒、窒息、助燃四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a flame, a skull, a person short of oxygen and an oxygen symbol with a flame. No text.
shots.narration: 再加上气体本身的危害，遇火就出事。

shots.section_title: 泄漏的危害：扩散加气体本身危害
shots.scene: 锈蚀、损坏的气瓶挂牌停用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rusty dented cylinder with an out of service tag, the supplier truck icon. No text.
shots.narration: 锈蚀损坏的气瓶，漏之前就停用。

shots.section_title: 大小泄漏怎么判断
shots.scene: 小泄漏：量少、慢、可控、惰性
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small slow leak from an inert gas cylinder, icons for small amount, slow and under control. No text.
shots.narration: 小泄漏：量少、慢、能控制、低危害。

shots.section_title: 大小泄漏怎么判断
shots.scene: 大泄漏：量大、失控、危害大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large uncontrolled gas release with a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 大泄漏：量大、控制不住、危害重。

shots.section_title: 大小泄漏怎么判断
shots.scene: 有毒气体漏一点也算大泄漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny leak from a toxic gas cylinder with a skull icon, put into the large leak box. No text.
shots.narration: 有毒气体，漏一点也算大泄漏。

shots.section_title: 大小泄漏怎么判断
shots.scene: 拿不准，按大泄漏处理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a question mark over a leaking cylinder, an arrow pointing to the evacuation sign. No text.
shots.narration: 拿不准，就按大泄漏处理。

shots.section_title: 小泄漏：通知、防护、通风放空
shots.scene: 提醒周围的人，穿戴防护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tells nearby students about a small leak while putting on safety goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 小泄漏：先告诉周围的人，穿好防护。
overlay: 小泄漏：通知、防护、通风放空

shots.section_title: 小泄漏：通知、防护、通风放空
shots.scene: 紧固接头仍漏，才是气瓶本身漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a joint tightened but the leak continuing at the cylinder valve body, a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 查清是接口漏，还是瓶本身漏。

shots.section_title: 小泄漏：通知、防护、通风放空
shots.scene: 受训人员把小泄漏气瓶移到通风处
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves a small leaking inert gas cylinder on a trolley to a ventilated hood area.
shots.narration: 受训人员确认安全，移到通风处放空。

shots.section_title: 小泄漏：通知、防护、通风放空
shots.scene: 移走旁边的可燃物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: paper and solvent bottles being moved away from a leaking cylinder. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃、助燃气体，移走旁边可燃物。

shots.section_title: 小泄漏：通知、防护、通风放空
shots.scene: 门口贴警示，人在外面等
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed lab door with a blank warning sign, people waiting outside. No text.
shots.narration: 撤出区域，门口警示，外面等放完。

shots.section_title: 小泄漏：通知、防护、通风放空
shots.scene: 漏气瓶退回供应单位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tagged leaking cylinder going back to the supplier, a hand opening a valve body crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 退回供应单位，绝不自己拆修。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体泄漏：关阀通风，杜绝火源
shots.scene: 闻到异味、听到嘶嘶声
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nose icon and an ear icon with a hissing line near a gas valve. No text.
shots.narration: 闻到异味、听到嘶声，可能漏了。
overlay: 可燃气体泄漏：关阀通风，杜绝火源

shots.section_title: 可燃气体泄漏：关阀通风，杜绝火源
shots.scene: 能安全靠近，就关阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand closing the cylinder valve, a tick, only when the area is safe. No text.
shots.narration: 能安全靠近，就先关阀。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体泄漏：关阀通风，杜绝火源
shots.scene: 开窗通风
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a window being opened and air flowing out of the lab. No text.
shots.narration: 开窗通风，让气散出去。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体泄漏：关阀通风，杜绝火源
shots.scene: 开关电器、点火、打电话都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light switch, a lighter and a mobile phone, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不开关电器，不点火，不在现场打电话。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体泄漏：关阀通风，杜绝火源
shots.scene: 到安全处再拨119
shots.prompt_en: The young male student outside the building dials a phone, an emergency icon. No text.
shots.narration: 撤到安全处，再打电话报警。

shots.section_title: 有毒和高压泄漏：先撤离，不冒险
shots.scene: 闻到刺激性气味，立即撤离
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers her nose and leads others out of the lab door.
shots.narration: 有毒气体泄漏，立即撤离。
overlay: 有毒和高压泄漏：先撤离，不冒险

shots.section_title: 有毒和高压泄漏：先撤离，不冒险
shots.scene: 返回关阀、救人打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person running back into a gas cloud towards a valve, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要冒险返回关阀，也不贸然救人。

shots.section_title: 有毒和高压泄漏：先撤离，不冒险
shots.scene: 高压气流用手去堵打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand covering a jet of high pressure gas, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 高压泄漏又猛又响，不用手去堵。

shots.section_title: 有毒和高压泄漏：先撤离，不冒险
shots.scene: 老李在远端关闭气源
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes a remote shut off valve in the corridor.
shots.narration: 能安全操作时，在远端关气源。

shots.section_title: 有毒和高压泄漏：先撤离，不冒险
shots.scene: 氧气泄漏处禁火，衣服沾氧远离火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen leak area with a no flame symbol and a person in clothing moving away from a flame. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气泄漏，严禁火源，衣服沾氧远离火。

shots.section_title: 大泄漏：撤离、报警、报告
shots.scene: 撤离随手关门，按下报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the lab door behind him and presses a building alarm button.
shots.narration: 大泄漏：撤离，关门，按下报警按钮。

shots.section_title: 大泄漏：撤离、报警、报告
shots.scene: 沿两条路线向上风方向撤到集合点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a floor plan with two exit routes and a wind sock showing people moving upwind to an assembly point. No text.
shots.narration: 看风向，往上风处撤到集合点。

shots.section_title: 大泄漏：撤离、报警、报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student dials an emergency number on a phone at the assembly point.
shots.narration: 着火拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.section_title: 大泄漏：撤离、报警、报告
shots.scene: 报告负责人、学院和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow chain from a student to the lab supervisor, the school office and the security office. No text.
shots.narration: 同时报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 大泄漏：撤离、报警、报告
shots.scene: 向救援人员说明情况
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student briefs the security officer, pointing at the building.
shots.narration: 说清什么气、在哪、里面有没有人。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 站侧面慢开阀、慢调压图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a person to the side of a valve and a slowly turned knob. No text.
shots.narration: 站侧面慢开阀，边看表边调压。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 检漏液检漏、明火打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a squeeze bottle with bubbles and a flame crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 检漏液检漏，严禁明火，漏了先泄压。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 关阀通风、撤离、报告图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a closed valve, an open window, an exit sign and a phone. No text.
shots.narration: 泄漏：能关就关，通风，撤离，报告。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一氧化碳报警器挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small carbon monoxide alarm and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：一氧化碳、硫化氢与窒息性气体。
